sections.title: From interested to paid, without the chasing.
sections.lead: Applications with your questions, approvals with a tap, waitlists with offers you control, and every payment next to the right name. In rupees, by UPI or card.

card.title: Tuesday Trivia Social · this week
card.note: Booked guests get where to meet. Guests on the {{brand.name}} app also get a push reminder 15 minutes before the start.

sections.title: Decide who gets a place, event by event.

items.title: Open
items.body: Anyone can book. A page with spots left. Book and pay in a couple of taps.

items.title: Applications
items.body: They apply, you choose. Ask the questions you want answered: who they are, who they’re bringing, what they’re hoping for. Approve with a tap.

items.title: Invite-only
items.body: Only people with your invite link or code can book.

items.title: Private offer
items.body: A place for one person. Send someone their own checkout link, checked against their phone number.

sections.title: One booking, up to four places.
sections.lead: A guest can book up to four places in one go, for themselves and their friends, with a name for each guest so your list is right before the door opens.
ticks: A name for every guest in the booking
A member price covers the member’s own place; friends pay the usual price
The whole booking checks in together at the door

sections.title: A full event, still filling.
sections.lead: When the event is full, new bookings join the waitlist. When someone drops out of a free event, the next person on the waitlist gets the place. For a paid event, send waitlisted guests an offer that stays open for as long as you choose.
ticks: Free events move the next person up for you
You set how long each offer stays open, up to a day
Guests get a reminder before their offer runs out

sections.title: Paid in rupees, no screenshots.

items.title: UPI or card
items.body: Guests pay at booking through Razorpay. Every payment lands next to the right name.

items.title: Refunds by your policy
items.body: Set a cancellation policy per event. Refunds follow it, and the fee is on sales net of refunds.

items.title: Payouts
items.body: By default, guests pay into your own Razorpay account, and it reaches your bank on Razorpay’s usual schedule. {{brand.name}} bills its fee afterwards. Payment gateway fees are separate.

sections.foot: 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 per 30-day billing cycle · Free events stay free · 30 days free from your first event

sections.title: Know which post sold the tickets.
sections.lead: Give every promoter, venue and post its own link. Each one shows how many people opened it, booked through it and checked in.

items.question: Can I approve each guest myself?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on applications, ask your questions, and approve or decline each person. Approved guests pay to confirm their place.

items.question: Can guests pay by UPI?
items.answer: Yes. Guests pay by UPI or card at booking, through Razorpay. Every payment is matched to the right name.

items.question: Can one person book for a group?
items.answer: Yes, up to four places in one booking, with a name for each guest. A member price applies to the member’s own place only.

items.question: What happens when someone cancels?
items.answer: Refunds follow the cancellation policy you set for the event. On a free event, the next person on the waitlist gets the place; on a paid one, you can send waitlisted guests an offer.

items.question: Where does the money go?
items.answer: By default, into your own Razorpay account, and from there to your bank on Razorpay’s usual schedule. Setting up Razorpay includes its KYC check, which usually takes 1 to 2 working days. Free events don’t need it.

items.question: Can an event be invite-only?
items.answer: Yes. Make it invite-only and share your invite link or code, or send one person a private offer with their own checkout.

items.question: Can I bring bookings from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Import your guest list from a CSV or Excel file and take new bookings on {{brand.name}} whenever you’re ready.
